comparison.objective: Unfold a laptop stand to full width and seat both support rods in the highest slots; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual articulated unfolding and two rod-slot seating versus long-rail regrasping, spring-tab/prong latching at front and rear, telescoping adjustment, and screw fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Stand width, both pins seated, stable table contact, containment, and release versus four load-bearing prongs, spring return, rack-unit match, and screws.
comparison.reason: There is some articulated bimanual seating overlap, but the candidate meaningfully adds sequential positive latching across posts while maintaining prior engagement and subsequent fastening.
